# Missing or misconfigured credentials cause immediate failure

OpenAI client construction and Azure provider initialization raise LLMProviderError when required environment credentials or endpoint/deployment values are absent, leading to runtime configuration failures.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/llm/provider.py` — `knowledge_compiler.llm.provider.OpenAIProvider.__init__`
